name: Jeduthun
title: One of David's three leading temple singers
summary: Jeduthun was a Levitical musician whom David appointed to lead the singing service at the sanctuary, along with Asaph and Heman. His sons led the temple music with lyres, harps, and cymbals, and several psalms bear his name in their headings.

keyEvents.title: Appointed to lead the temple music
keyEvents.description: David set apart Jeduthun along with Asaph and Heman to prophesy with lyres, harps, and cymbals in the service of the house of the Lord.

keyEvents.title: The Music at the Temple Dedication
keyEvents.description: Jeduthun's descendants took part among the singers and musicians when the glory of God filled the temple during its dedication.
